sam_share.said:
Lent jellyfin (port 8096) to everyone in your groups, as many at once as want it. To let fewer in at once, change it on your home page, or `svrngs share 8096 --limit <number>`.
Each person is signed in to it as themselves by what answers on port 8097, with nothing typed.
svrngs is running here already, so they can open it now.
`svrngs unshare jellyfin` stops lending it.

ana_join.said:
You're in two, as Ana.
two's folder is /tmp/two-run-b/ana/svrngs/two: what anyone in two puts there reaches this computer, and what you put there reaches theirs.

ana_device_link_said:
A link that adds another computer or phone of yours to two: open it there, and it joins as you, Ana, asked no name. Send it to nobody else: whoever opens it joins as you. Any link you sent before stops letting anyone new in; everyone it let in stays.
A computer or phone already in two on its own stays as it joined.
It works for a day, while this computer is on:

  svrngs://join/<the token>

or, to open it in a browser:

  http://localhost:63771/#<the token>

On a phone, each app opens at an address of its own under localhost:63771, which can see which app is opened.

Leave this running; Ctrl-C stops it.
